notes.title: Dev log 6 : Reconstructing the Truth – How Recall Powers Work?
notes.content:
[h2][b]Greetings Detectives,[/b][/h2]

In Private Eye: The Young Heir, every story hides another one beneath it—buried under silence, lies, and lost memories. As players step into the shoes of Hakeem, our determined investigator, they’ll need more than just sharp eyes and a notebook to uncover the truth. They’ll need to reconstruct the past itself.
That’s where our cornerstone mechanic comes in: Recall.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106591/33e776ac5e04ca0dd3d581db5b8b9b7b127f6ced.png[/img]

[h3][b]🧠 The Recall Mechanic: Memory as a Tool[/b][/h3]
At the heart of every quest in Private Eye: The Young Heir is the Recall system—our unique mechanic that allows players to rebuild key moments from the past inside the Mirza mansion. Using gathered information—statements from characters, examined items, and discovered clues—players can piece together how events unfolded in a given space.
Think of Recall as investigative time travel. You're not watching a cutscene; you're recreating the scene with the fragments you've found. Where did the suspect stand? What object was moved? What was said—or left unsaid? The more accurate your reconstruction, the closer you get to revealing the truth.

[h3][b]🔍 Puzzles Rooted in Reality[/b][/h3]
These reconstructed moments are more than just cinematic flourishes—they’re full-blown interactive puzzles. Each scene asks the player to think critically about the information they’ve gathered. Was that wine glass really broken during a struggle, or was it placed there afterward to throw someone off? Why are two witnesses describing the same event so differently?
Environmental awareness becomes a key skill. Players will need to scan every corner of a room, examine objects from multiple angles, and weigh testimonies against physical evidence. Every detail matters, and nothing is placed without purpose.

[h3][b]🗣️ Dialogue Drives Discovery[/b][/h3]
Outside of the Recall scenes, players will move through the mansion, engaging with its complex cast of characters. These aren’t just flavor conversations—they’re central to how the story unfolds. You’ll question motives, follow up on inconsistencies, and uncover buried tensions between the people who lived (and possibly killed) in this house.
Some characters lie. Some protect. Some twist the truth just enough to buy time. It’s your job to read between the lines, extract key details, and decide who to trust—if anyone.

[h3][b]🎭 Your Mind is the Greatest Weapon[/b][/h3]
What sets Private Eye: The Young Heir apart is that the story isn’t handed to you—it’s built by you. Every quest pushes the player to not just explore, but to interpret. The mansion becomes a living crime scene, and the Recall mechanic is the bridge between what was and what might have been.
By combining intricate puzzles with character-driven storytelling, we’re creating a detective experience that truly puts you in the role, not just as a question-asker, but as a scene-builder, a truth-seeker, and ultimately, the one who will decide what really happened.

[i][b]Stay sharp, detective. The past is only as reliable as the mind that remembers it.[/b][/i]

notes.title: Devlog 5: Kastanza Knight – The Butler with a Hidden Blade
notes.content:
[h2][b]Greetings Detectives, [/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106591/fed292ea207c578751264ccf2f9e305b432609ba.png[/img]

In the world of Private Eye: The Young Heir, every character holds secrets, and few are as enigmatic—or as dangerous—as Kastanza Knight. A woman who has lived many lives, Kastanza is not just the loyal butler of the Mirza estate—she is a survivor, a strategist, and a woman who refuses to be discarded.

[h3][b]A Life in the Shadows[/b][/h3]
At 57, Kastanza has spent decades shaping the fate of the Mirza family from behind the scenes. Once the right hand of Nizar Mirza, she was more than just a servant—she was his confidant, his fixer, and at times, his enforcer. Beneath the polished veneer of refined manners lies a woman forged in hardship. Raised in the criminal underworld of Britain, Kastanza learned early that the world does not reward weakness. Her past as an honorable thief came to an abrupt end when Nizar caught her mid-heist. But instead of punishment, she found something far more dangerous—[b]a purpose[/b].

Nizar saw her potential and gave her a role within his household, one that extended far beyond pouring tea and keeping the silverware polished. While the outside world saw a devoted butler, behind closed doors, she handled matters no ordinary servant would dare touch. But the years 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106591/0bc36b55e023ea92ce4e2312c870bd221b1fc9eb.png[/img]

have changed everything. Nizar is gone. His son, Amir, now holds the keys to the Mirza legacy. And for the first time in decades, Kastanza finds herself on uncertain ground.

[h3][b]A Heart Divided[/b][/h3]
Kastanza once considered Amir to be her own. After all, she had lost a child—one taken from her before she ever had the chance to be a mother. She poured all that love, all that loss, into raising Amir, shaping him into the man who now rules over the Mirza estate. But now, [b]he turns to another[/b]—a young upstart named Ali, someone Kastanza sees as nothing more than an interloper.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106591/0cf47ad99659ffca47545069066a41d381e94223.png[/img]

[b]Fear. Resentment. Betrayal[/b]. These emotions fester inside her, threatening to unravel the controlled, calculating woman she has always been. She has dedicated her life to this family, and yet, she is now seen as an aging relic, [b]a loose end to be tied up[/b]. But if there’s one thing Kastanza Knight has never been, it’s disposable.

[h3][b]Loyalty or Survival?[/b][/h3]
Kastanza is not the type to sit back and accept her fate. She is [b]a woman of action[/b], and when she feels the walls closing in, she does what she has always done—[b]she fights back[/b]. The question is, how far will she go? In a house already filled with secrets, Kastanza is about to become the most dangerous mystery of all.
For players of [b]Private Eye: The Young Heir[/b], Kastanza represents a layered challenge. She is not an open book, nor does she make it easy to see the full truth behind her actions. She operates in whispers, in careful moves, in plans that unfold long before anyone realizes they’ve begun. [b]Will she be an ally? A villain? Or something far more complicated?[/b]

As you step into the shoes of Hakeem, the detective unraveling the Mirza estate’s mysteries, keep one thing in mind: [b]Kastanza Knight never plays a game she doesn’t intend to win.[/b]

notes.title: Devlog 4: Amir Mirza
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106591/37539e8f10869fd029210195125981e96de381d2.png[/img]

[h3][b]Devlog 4: Amir Mirza - A Legacy in Conflict[/b][/h3]
Private Eye: The Young Heir - Unveiling a Complex Protagonist
At Lucky 7 Studios, we believe a compelling mystery isn’t just about uncovering secrets—it’s about understanding the people at its heart. Amir Mirza, one of the pivotal characters in Private Eye: The Young Heir, is more than a name in a file. He’s a man shaped by family, power, and the weight of legacy. In this devlog, we explore Amir’s journey from an idealistic son to a leader navigating a perilous empire.
[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]The Foundations of a Young Heir[/b][/h3]
Amir’s childhood was marked by loss and resilience. His mother’s passing left a void in his life, one partially filled by Kastanza, the loyal family butler who stepped into a maternal role. However, the arrival of Amir’s stepmother and half-sister Zara shifted the family dynamics. Ignored by his stepmother, Amir found solace in Kastanza’s care and in the ambition instilled by his father, Nizar.
Nizar saw greatness in Amir, often painting a future where his son would follow in his footsteps as a titan of business. This vision became Amir’s guiding light, fueling his desire to live up to his father’s expectations.
[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Shadows of a Father’s Empire[/b][/h3]
As Amir grew older, the cracks in Nizar’s world became more apparent. While he admired his father’s power, he couldn’t ignore the darker underpinnings of Nizar’s business dealings. Despite these revelations, Amir’s admiration for Nizar remained steadfast—a complex mix of loyalty and ambition.
Nizar’s sudden death in his sleep thrust Amir into a position of enormous responsibility. Barely in his twenties, he inherited not just a thriving empire but the fear and respect that came with his father’s name.
[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Becoming Nizar’s Heir[/b][/h3]
With Kastanza’s guidance and the lessons gleaned from watching Nizar, Amir filled the void left by his father’s passing. He adopted Nizar’s commanding presence, enforcing his will with the same iron grip. For years, this approach maintained his authority, but it came at a cost.
The fear that once served Nizar so effectively began to wane under Amir’s leadership. The board of directors at NMSCo, Nizar’s company, started to question Amir’s ability to lead. They had seen a glimpse of life beyond Nizar’s reign and yearned for a new direction—one free of the intimidation that defined Amir’s rule.
[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]A Crumbling Foundation[/b][/h3]
Unaware of the board’s growing dissent, Amir focused on preserving his father’s legacy. However, his heavy-handed approach alienated those around him. Paranoia began to creep in as he noticed subtle shifts in loyalty within his inner circle.
Desperate to prove himself and escape the shadow of his father, Amir attempted a dramatic transformation. He decided to redefine his role—not as a tyrant, but as a force for good. With newfound determination, he used his power to help those around him, including Zara and Omari, turning over a new leaf in an effort to reconcile his past with his future.
[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Good Intentions, Unintended Consequences[/b][/h3]
While Amir’s change of heart brought moments of personal fulfillment, it left him vulnerable. His shift in focus caused a lapse in oversight, culminating in a catastrophic security failure—a Greek Ambassador’s detainment that nearly severed a vital partnership.
Lucia Rossi, NMSCo’s CSO, stepped in to save the day, securing the ambassador’s release and solidifying her position as the board’s preferred alternative to Amir. The incident gave the board the ammunition they needed to take action against him.
Stay tuned for the next devlog, where we delve deeper into Amir’s battle to hold onto his empire and the lengths he’ll go to preserve his father’s legacy.

notes.title: Devlog 3: Recall - Revisiting the Truth
notes.content:
[h3][b]Private Eye: The Young Heir - A Deep Dive into Detective Fantasy[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106591/5f475bccce11cc404c807ba1bee64060f6ae8c31.png[/img]

At Lucky 7 Studios, we’re crafting a detective game that goes beyond conventional mystery-solving mechanics. With Private Eye: The Young Heir, our aim is to immerse players fully into the role of a sleuth, giving them innovative tools to unravel a complex narrative. One of the most groundbreaking features in our game is the Recall mechanic—a system that blends dialogue, exploration, and deduction into a seamless investigative experience.

[h3][b]Gameplay Focus: The Recall Mechanic[/b][/h3]
The Recall feature allows players to step into the past—literally. As Hakeem questions suspects, he gathers testimonies that paint a vivid picture of past events. Once he has enough information, he can activate a Recall to revisit the scene described by the suspect and investigate it firsthand. This mechanic transforms testimonies from mere words into interactive experiences, enabling players to directly engage with the events as described.

[h3][b]Reliving the Scene[/b][/h3]
Imagine questioning a nervous maid about the events of a stormy night. She hesitantly describes hearing a crash in the study, followed by hurried footsteps. With Recall, you’re no longer relying solely on her account. Instead, you’re transported to that very study, experiencing the moment through her words. You can inspect the crash site, interact with objects, and uncover details she might have missed—or conveniently omitted.
This mechanic ensures that players aren’t just passive recipients of information but active participants in validating and expanding upon testimonies. It’s about empowering players to take control of the investigation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106591/8938878b6fba76485b3957f0dec2657ba4d2b98b.gif[/img]

[h3][b]The Power of Cross-Examination[/b][/h3]
The Recall feature truly shines when testimonies collide. In Private Eye: The Young Heir, no mystery is one-sided. Different characters provide conflicting accounts of the same events. Once you’ve collected Recalls from multiple suspects, you can cross-examine them, juxtaposing the scenes to spot inconsistencies or outright lies.
For example, the maid claims the room was dark during the crash, but a Recall from the butler reveals a lit lamp at the same time. Such discrepancies push players to question motives and seek the truth hidden beneath layers of deceit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106591/81f3762dd95b827ba38947d5f73837b554f6b04a.gif[/img]
[h3][b]Building the Case with Recall[/b][/h3]
The Recall mechanic isn’t just about verifying testimonies—it’s about understanding the characters and their motivations. By stepping into the shoes of witnesses, players gain insight into their personalities, fears, and secrets. Every detail matters, from the angle of a fallen vase to the position of a suspicious footprint.
This feature also deepens the emotional weight of the narrative. Witnessing a suspect’s version of events helps players empathize—or grow suspicious. It’s a delicate balance that keeps players engaged, challenging them to piece together the puzzle of who can be trusted and who is hiding the truth.

[h3][b]The Detective Fantasy Comes to Life[/b][/h3]
With the Recall feature, Private Eye: The Young Heir delivers a detective experience like no other. By allowing players to relive and scrutinize testimonies, we’ve created a mechanic that combines narrative depth, environmental exploration, and logical deduction into one cohesive system.
Every Recall brings players closer to the truth—or deeper into the web of lies. It’s up to you, the detective, to decide who’s telling the truth and who’s manipulating the past to cover their tracks.
This is detective fantasy redefined, and we can’t wait for you to experience it.

[b]Stay tuned for the next dev log as we explore another feature designed to make Private Eye: The Young Heir the ultimate detective adventure.
[/b]

notes.title: Devlog 2: Environmental Gameplay
notes.content:
[h2]Private Eye: The Young Heir - A Deep Dive into Detective Fantasy[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106591/a3ebcaa57053b98b4f0632122202350e81bc635e.png[/img]

At Lucky 7 Studios, we believe that the detective fantasy in gaming is often overlooked, and that’s where Private Eye: The Young Heir steps in. This narrative-driven detective experience is designed to fully immerse players in the role of an investigator, using intuitive gameplay to unfold a deeply engaging mystery.

[h3]Gameplay Focus: The Art of Observation[/h3]
In [b]Private Eye: The Young Heir,[/b] gameplay is divided into two core mechanics: [b]narrative puzzles[/b] and [b]environmental puzzles[/b], both of which form the heart of our detective experience.
Environmental puzzles play a vital role in any detective fiction, allowing players to act on their instincts and sharpen their perception. Here, your immediate surroundings aren’t just background—they’re brimming with clues waiting to be uncovered. One of the standout mechanics we’ve created is the [b]ping system[/b], where our protagonist, Hakeem, hones in on points of interest within his environment, bringing the player closer to key discoveries.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106591/3fa7bc974f4d174e709ed41d0824d839b3c4429e.gif[/img]

[h3]A Closer Look at the Crime Scene[/h3]
Take, for instance, the scene in the victim's office. With Hakeem’s sharp investigative instincts, players will explore every corner of the room, discovering hidden objects that reveal deeper layers of the mystery. Each interaction provides fresh insights into the case and the characters involved, turning every scene into a puzzle waiting to be solved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106591/1b2905f3922714da776eb05e04b9ae5757d6efb1.gif[/img]

[h3]The Power of Item Examination[/h3]
A good detective knows that the smallest details often hold the greatest significance. In Private Eye: The Young Heir, item examination is a crucial tool in your investigative toolkit. By inspecting items throughout the mansion, you’ll piece together information about the world and the people who inhabit it.
In one instance, Hakeem scrutinizes a stack of books in the murder victim’s (Amir’s) office. What seems at first like ordinary clutter turns into a window into Amir’s mind. His intelligence, taste, and ambitions slowly unfold before you, painting a portrait of a man whose death doesn’t seem like a simple accident.
[h3]
Building the Case[/h3]
Through these discoveries, players won’t just solve puzzles—they’ll understand [b]who Amir was[/b] and what forces may have led to his demise. Every clue uncovered offers a deeper understanding of the characters, driving players to make informed assumptions as they unravel the truth behind the crime.
By empowering players with the tools to explore, observe, and deduce, Private Eye: The Young Heir delivers a detective experience that stays with you long after the mystery is solved.

▶️ Finally don't forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/8bFr5qXk8A][b]Discord[/b][/url] server where you can chat with the Devs and stay up to date with the game development.

Catch y'all soon.

[i][b]~Lucky7 Studio[/b][/i]

notes.title: Dev Log 1 - How does it all begin?
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Detectives[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106591/64991723ec47ce92ae03ee5fdaa00f599a0ee3b6.png[/img]

In the early 1900’s a wealthy man by the name of Nizar founded a securities company that provided private security to the upper echelon of society. Politicians, royalty and holy men were the kind of people Nizar surrounded himself with. Promises of wealth, status and safety was Nizar's favorite method of maintaining control over the people he interacted with. Nizar was held in the highest regard and always spoken fondly of publicly. But in reality people were just too afraid to stand up to him or challenge him. Nizar was a father to two children, Amir and Zara. Amir was always the perfect son. He was promised the proverbial “Keys to the kingdom” even though he was never the kind to bully or manipulate. Nevertheless Amir's character wouldn’t allow himself  to fail his father or tarnish his legacy. Zara, however, was always the spoiled daughter who could never do wrong. Even though she was Nizar’s favorite in most people’s eyes she was never going to take on the mantle of the family name.
After Nizar’s death Zara and Amir were separated. Zara taken away by her mother, Amir left to take on the family legacy all on his own. 

As Amir got older and started learning more and more about his father’s life and his role in the family’s coming business. From the outside his father was the owner of a very successful security company but if you take a closer look his company offered much more than just security.

He learned everything there is to do in his father’s business and he was dedicated to being his successor. from common folk to the upper echelon, His father taught him how to talk and how to walk and Amir was very good at it. But with that came the dangers of that lifestyle. Learning everyone’s secrets made him a very feared man but also meant that he had a huge target on his back.

Now we are in the year 1960. Amir is the president of the securities company and is well established as a city and community leader. After successfully taking over his father’s place, Amir now knows what his father’s life was like and why he was how he was. Amir doesn’t know exactly how and why his father was killed but he understands what leads a man in that position to that unfortunate fate. And Amir feels as if he is going to face that similar fate soon.

Amir invited all his closest friends and family to a party at his house. Although he doesn’t see them as friends and family, rather allies and enemies. The reason for this party is a mystery, why did he invite this specific group? Who are these people? What are their backgrounds?

Many years have passed since and now that Nizar has been killed and for Amir many questions are yet to be answered. Who killed him? Why? And what is gonna happen to the family legacy?


▶️ Finally don't forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/8bFr5qXk8A][b]Discord[/b][/url] server where you can chat with the Devs and stay up to date with the game development.

Catch y'all soon.

[i][b]~Lucky7 Studio[/b][/i]
